title: Negotiation
learning_outcomes: Explain interests and positions in the context of negotiation.
Compare and distinguish alternatives in the context of negotiation.
Apply objective criteria in the context of negotiation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about agreement in the context of negotiation.

lessons.title: Interests and positions
lessons.outcome: Explain interests and positions in the context of negotiation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving interests and positions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to negotiation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain interests and positions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of interests and positions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Alternatives
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish alternatives in the context of negotiation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving alternatives; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to negotiation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain alternatives from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of alternatives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Objective criteria
lessons.outcome: Apply objective criteria in the context of negotiation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving objective criteria; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to negotiation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain objective criteria from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of objective criteria; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Agreement
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about agreement in the context of negotiation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving agreement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to negotiation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain agreement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of agreement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of interests and positions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of alternatives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of objective criteria; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of agreement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
